title: agent harnesses / Select a harness
content:
## Select a harness Select a harness before you submit the first prompt for a session: 1. [Open the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}](/docs/agents/run/chat-view.md) or [open the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md). 1. Select **New Chat** (`+`) in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}, or select **New** in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}. 1. In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, select the folder or GitHub repository for the session. 1. Open the **Session Target** UI control and select an available harness or the Cloud target. ![Screenshot showing the Session Target UI control in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}.](../images/agent-harnesses/agents-window-session-target-2.png) The control only lists targets whose [requirements](#requirements-and-setup) are met in the current window. ### Choose a built-in agent After selecting a harness, choose an available built-in agent from the agent picker. The available built-in agents depend on the harness: | Harness | Built-in agents | |---------|----------------| | **Copilot** |
  • **Ask** answers questions and researches your codebase without making changes. It only uses read-only tools and can't edit files or run state-changing commands.
  • **Agent** implements changes and validates the result.
  • **[Plan](/docs/agents/run/planning.md)** researches a task and creates an implementation plan for you to review. Invoke it with `/plan`.
| | **Local** |
  • **Ask** answers questions without changing your code.
  • **Agent** implements changes and validates the result.
  • **Plan** researches a task and creates an implementation plan for you to review.
| Switching agents doesn't change the harness. You can also select [custom agents](/docs/agent-customization/custom-agents.md) from the same picker. In the Copilot harness, [Autopilot](/docs/agents/run/approvals.md#how-autopilot-works) is a mode with its own workflow, not an additional built-in agent. Your harness choice is separate from where the session changes code. In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, you can also [choose between a folder and a worktree](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md#choose-where-an-agent-makes-changes) or [run a session in a Dev Container](/docs/agents/run/agents-window.md#run-a-session-in-a-dev-container). ### Identify your current harness To identify the current harness for a chat session, use one of the following methods: * In the editor window, the active harness is shown as a prefix in the chat title. * In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, the chat input box shows the active harness as the watermark. * In the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}, hover over the session entry in the sessions list to see a tooltip showing the harness.
